title: Registration for CaseVerse 2026 Now Open
author: CaseVerse Team
excerpt: Team registration for Bangladesh's premier national SDG-aligned case competition is officially open.
content:
## Registration Now Open

We are thrilled to announce that registration for **CaseVerse 2026** is now officially open.

### Who Can Participate?

- Undergraduate students from recognized universities across Bangladesh
- Teams of **3–4 members** from the same university

### Important Dates

| Milestone | Date |
|-----------|------|
| Registration Opens | February 1, 2026 |
| Registration Closes | March 15, 2026 |
| Round 1 Begins | April 1, 2026 |

### How to Register

1. Form your team of 3–4 members
2. Visit the [Register page](/register)
3. Fill in your team details
4. Submit your registration

Don't miss this opportunity to showcase your strategic thinking and innovation on a national platform!

title: SDG Workshop Series Announced for Participants
author: CaseVerse Team
excerpt: A series of free workshops on Sustainable Development Goals will be held before the competition begins.
content:
We're excited to announce a **free workshop series** designed to help participants understand and align their solutions with the UN Sustainable Development Goals.

## Workshop Schedule

### Workshop 1: Understanding SDGs
- **Date:** February 20, 2026
- **Time:** 3:00 PM – 5:00 PM
- **Platform:** Zoom (link will be shared after registration)

### Workshop 2: Business Solutions for SDGs
- **Date:** February 27, 2026
- **Time:** 3:00 PM – 5:00 PM
- **Platform:** Zoom

### Workshop 3: Crafting Your Pitch
- **Date:** March 5, 2026
- **Time:** 3:00 PM – 5:00 PM
- **Platform:** Zoom

> These workshops are optional but highly recommended for all registered teams.

Register for the competition first to receive workshop invitations.

title: Round 1 Results Coming Soon
author: CaseVerse Team
excerpt: Results for Round 1 (Case Solution Submission) will be announced shortly. Stay tuned for updates.
content:
Round 1 of CaseVerse 2026 has concluded. We received an overwhelming response from teams across Bangladesh.

Results will be announced by **April 20, 2026**. Shortlisted teams will be notified via email.

### What's Next?

- Shortlisted teams advance to **Round 2 (Online Video Content)**
- Round 2 guidelines will be shared with qualifying teams
- Timeline for Round 2: April 25 – May 15, 2026

Thank you to all teams who participated. Good luck!
